title: Börek
description: A traditional dish from Türkiye, centered on feta, spinach, chicken egg, phyllo pastry. A measured home-kitchen version organized by cooking step.

steps.instruction: Prepare the filling ingredients: cook or soften any components that require it, let cool, then mix into an even filling.
Layer the prepared elements evenly in the baking dish, spreading filling right to the edges.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for about 34 minutes until set, golden and cooked through. Cool on a rack.
